subject: english
officialSource: CISCE ICSE Regulations and Syllabuses (English Paper 1 & 2 Code 01)

chapters.title: Tenses and Verb Agreement
chapters.description: Rules of Simple, Continuous, Perfect, and Perfect Continuous tenses; Subject-Verb Concord across singular and compound subjects.

levels.title: Tenses in Context
levels.description: Identifying and applying appropriate tense forms in continuous passages.
subtopics: Fill in blanks with correct verb tense forms

levels.title: Subject-Verb Agreement
levels.description: Singular and plural verbs with collective nouns, either...or, neither...nor, as well as, along with.

levels.title: Chapter 1 Review & Verb Mastery
levels.description: Grammar review of tenses and verb agreement in passage format.

chapters.title: Prepositions and Phrasal Verbs
chapters.description: Prepositions of time, place, direction; fixed prepositions and idiomatic phrasal verbs.

levels.title: Prepositions of Time and Place
levels.description: Distinctions between in/at/on, since/for, between/among, beside/besides.

levels.title: Phrasal Verbs & Fixed Prepositions
levels.description: Common phrasal verbs (look after, call off, give in, put up with) and verbs taking fixed prepositions.
subtopics: Fixed prepositions with adjectives and verbs

levels.title: Chapter 2 Review & Preposition Drill
levels.description: Review of standard ICSE Question 4(b) preposition sets.

chapters.title: Sentence Transformation and Synthesis
chapters.description: Transformations using 'No sooner...than', 'Hardly...when', Active/Passive voice, Direct/Indirect speech, and degrees of comparison.

levels.title: Active and Passive Voice
levels.description: Conversion between active and passive forms across assertive, imperative, and interrogative sentences.

levels.title: Direct and Indirect Speech
levels.description: Reporting statements, questions, commands, and exclamations with reporting verb and tense shifts.

levels.title: Chapter 3 Review & Transformation Mastery
subtopics: Rewrite according to instruction without changing meaning
